entries.value: A defaced altar humming with faint power
A clear pool that reflects the wrong room
A weathered statue whose eyes seem to follow you
A prisoner chained to the wall, half-mad
A sealed door with a riddle carved above it
A shimmering archway that leads elsewhere
A deep well exhaling cold air
A mural depicting the dungeon's downfall
A forge gone cold, tools scattered mid-task
A library of mouldering, unreadable books
A chessboard of black and white tiles, a game abandoned mid-move
A great bronze bell with no clapper that rings when touched
A fountain of clear water that never overflows its basin
A wall of carved names, every one of them struck through
A pit heaped with the bones of a hundred creatures
A throne of fused weapons, cold to the touch
A row of iron levers, not one of them labelled
A sarcophagus, its lid shifted just slightly ajar
A pool of quicksilver that ripples when you speak
A stone face set in the wall, its mouth a keyhole
A hanging cage that sways though there is no wind
A mosaic map of tunnels that do not match this place
A shrine to a forgotten god, its offerings still fresh
A locked chest that whispers when you draw near
A staircase that descends further than the floor below allows
A ring of standing stones humming just below hearing
A great scale, one pan weighed down by nothing you can see
A mirror that shows the room empty of you
A dry fountain shaped like a screaming mouth
A wall of masks, each frozen in a different terror
A pendulum swinging slowly over a cracked flagstone
An orrery of tarnished brass, its spheres still turning
A bricked-up doorway with fresh scratches on the mortar
A well of black water that swallows every sound
A headless statue, the head nowhere to be found
A carved relief that seems to depict you, arriving
A trapdoor set in the ceiling rather than the floor
A basin of ash cradling a single unburnt feather
A door of solid iron, warm to the touch and faintly ticking
A chained tome bound in iron, its pages turning on their own
A colossal skeleton half-embedded in the far wall
A vast hourglass, its sand running upward
